_meta.name: CodeTracer Design System — component manifest
_meta.description: Structural inventory of every published component (component sets + single components) in the CodeTracer Design System Figma library.

fieldNotes.variantProperties: Variant axes and their allowed values (long value lists capped with '…+N more').
fieldNotes.variantCount: Total number of variant combinations in the set.
fieldNotes.properties: Component property definitions: name -> type (VARIANT | TEXT | BOOLEAN | INSTANCE_SWAP).
fieldNotes.variantError: (resolved) previously flagged sets with variant conflicts; none remain.

components.name: agent-status-icon
components.description: Caption-bar agent glyph.

components.name: progress-bar
components.description: Progress bar — determinate milestone progress for a fleet run.

components.name: agent-progress-indicator
components.description: Agent progress indicator (caption bar) — spec §3.

components.name: workspace-view-switcher
components.description: Switches the whole editor between the user’s workspace and the agent’s isolated copy.

components.name: file-tree-row
components.description: One row of the agent workspace file tree: disclosure + glyph + name + file-state badge.

components.name: file-state-badge
components.description: File state badge — a small colour-coded pill showing a file's status in the agent's workspace.

components.name: file-diff-indicator
components.description: Marks a file as changed against the base state, before any diff is opened.

components.name: coverage-gutter-mark
components.description: Coverage gutter mark — a thin bar in the editor gutter showing DeepReview line coverage from the agent's test runs.

components.name: inline-value-label
components.description: Inline value label — a live variable value shown inline on a code line, rendered as a DeepReview flow annotation (NOT a text comment).

components.name: execution-context-selector
components.description: Chooses which recorded execution drives the inline values and gutter marks: latest run · a specific test · a comparison of two.

components.name: milestone-row
components.description: Milestone row (Agent Activity pane) — spec §6.1.

components.name: milestone-priority-tag
components.description: The priority a milestone carries in the agent plan — high · medium · low.

components.name: event-row
components.description: Event row — one entry in the Agent Panel's event stream (the net-new heart of the panel).

components.name: filter-chip
components.description: Filter chip — a toggle chip for filtering the event stream (All events · Thoughts · Tools · Edits · Diffs) and for small segmented controls (e.g.

components.name: streaming-indicator
components.description: Streaming indicator — shows the liveness of an agent's event stream so the user knows whether work is still flowing.

components.name: stream-empty-state
components.description: The three ways the stream can show nothing: not started, catching up on history, or filtered to empty.

components.name: agent-chip
components.description: Agent chip — one configured agent in the Launch fan-out (each chip = one parallel session).

components.name: advanced-disclosure
components.description: Keeps Harbor’s full task configuration available without putting it in front of the common case.

components.name: status-pill
components.description: Status pill — a compact, colour-coded badge that encodes a run or event's state at a glance.

components.name: elapsed-time
components.description: How long a run has been going, or how long it took.

components.name: prompt-ack
components.description: Confirms what happened to a steering prompt.

components.name: mode-switcher
components.description: Unified Diff ⇄ Full Files.

components.name: modified-file-row
components.description: One file in the review set: state, path, and modified-line count.

components.name: diff-line
components.description: One line of a diff: old line number, new line number, sign, code.

components.name: context-expander
components.description: Reveals surrounding unchanged code around a hunk.

components.name: draggable-edge-line
components.description: The grab handle on a context boundary.

components.name: diff-gutter-decoration
components.description: Full Files mode: the normal CodeTracer editor with modified lines marked, fully loaded rather than clipped to hunks, and read-only by default.

components.name: call-trace-row
components.description: One node of the agent’s test-execution tree in the call trace panel, filtered to tests and updating as each test completes.

components.name: session-status-dot
components.description: Status indicator dot for a session card.

components.name: session-action-button
components.description: Compact action button shown on a session card.

components.name: session-activity-row
components.description: One activity line inside a session card: icon + truncating label + elapsed duration.

components.name: session-card
components.description: A single agent session in the dashboard feed.

components.name: session-role-chip
components.description: One session in the orchestration, labelled by role.

components.name: session-iteration-block
components.description: OPTION 2 — Iteration ledger.

components.name: session-graph-row
components.description: OPTION 3 — Topology gutter.

components.name: session-tree-group
components.description: Role group header in the Session Navigator.

components.name: session-tree-item
components.description: Session Navigator entry, per WebUI-PRD.

components.name: session-agent-column
components.description: One competitor in arena mode — a complete execution loop belonging to a single agent.

components.name: milestone-segment
components.description: One milestone as a bar segment.

components.name: milestone-deliverable-cell
components.description: One deliverable inside a milestone, as a single cell in the deliverable matrix.

components.name: milestone-rail
components.description: OPTION 1 — Segmented progress rail.

components.name: milestone-matrix-row
components.description: OPTION 2 — Deliverable matrix.

components.name: milestone-node
components.description: OPTION 3 — Dependency rail.

components.name: milestone-timeline-row
components.description: OPTION 4 — Time waterfall.

components.name: agent-task-label
components.description: Caption-bar task name — the current milestone description from the agent plan.

components.name: milestone-counter
components.description: Completed / total milestones from the agent plan.

components.name: progress-percentage
components.description: Numeric completion next to the progress bar.

components.name: agent-context-menu
components.description: Right-click menu on the caption-bar progress indicator.

components.name: workspace-readonly-banner
components.description: Persistent banner shown while the editor is displaying the agent’s workspace, which is read-only.

components.name: execution-slider
components.description: Execution / loop slider — steps through the iterations of a line or function that ran multiple times, scrubbing which execution the inline values reflect.

components.name: execution-comparison-view
components.description: Two recorded executions of the same code side by side, with their inline values aligned line for line.

components.name: milestone-list
components.description: The agent plan rendered as a checklist, assembled from milestone-row instances including nested children.

components.name: tool-call-card
components.description: A file-editing tool call, enriched with DeepReview context: which functions changed and what it did to coverage.

components.name: test-result-card
components.description: A completed test with its recorded flow data: pass/fail, duration, how many times the function ran, and the values captured.

components.name: card-action-row
components.description: The action pair at the foot of a tool-call or test-result card — jumps from the activity feed to the code or the recorded trace.

components.name: event-stream
components.description: The live feed for one session: filter bar, time-grouped event rows, and a liveness indicator pinned at the foot.

components.name: code-diff-block
components.description: Monospace code and diff rendering inside the event stream — what the diff and file_edit rows expand into.

components.name: timestamp-divider
components.description: Timestamp / grouping divider — a subtle labelled separator that groups the event stream by time.

components.name: config-row
components.description: One line of Harbor task configuration: label on the left, current value on the right, click to expand and edit.

components.name: omnibar-agent-command
components.description: Launching an agent task from the omnibar.

components.name: fan-out-summary
components.description: States the consequence of the current agents[] configuration before the user commits: how many parallel sessions this task will create.

components.name: fleet-list
components.description: Every run across every task in one view — the supervision surface.

components.name: run-row
components.description: One session at a glance in the fleet: state, which agent is running it, size of the change so far, and elapsed time.

components.name: task-group-header
components.description: Groups the racing sessions of one task so a fan-out reads as a single thing rather than N unrelated runs.

components.name: diff-stat
components.description: Diff stat — the two-colour '+N −M' added/removed line counts.

components.name: steer-bar
components.description: Sends a follow-up prompt to a running session — redirect without restarting.

components.name: review-workspace-header
components.description: The frame around a DeepReview session: what is being reviewed, which trace drives the overlay, and which of the two review modes is showing.

components.name: trace-context-selector
components.description: Chooses which recorded trace drives the Omniscience overlay across the review.

components.name: modified-files-panel
components.description: The review set, shared by both DeepReview modes and the primary way to navigate a review.

components.name: diff-file-section
components.description: One file rendered as a review section in Unified Diff mode: header, expandable context, and one or more hunks.

components.name: diff-file-header
components.description: Identifies one file section of the unified diff: path plus the usual diff metadata.

components.name: diff-hunk
components.description: One contiguous changed region: the @@ range marker and its lines.

components.name: diff-omniscience-overlay
components.description: The standard CodeTracer Omniscience overlay laid on top of the unified diff — same coverage marks, inline values and loop slider as the editor, restricted to lines currently loaded into t…

components.name: delivery-card
components.description: Where the work lands: delivery mode, target branch or PR, and the action that ships it.

components.name: accept-reject
components.description: Per-hunk review decision.

components.name: run-comparison-view
components.description: Racing runs of one task side by side so a winner can be picked.

components.name: waiting-for-input-alert
components.description: The agent has stopped and needs an answer before it can continue — the highest-urgency state in the system.

components.name: permission-request-modal
components.description: Blocking approval for a risky or outward-facing action the agent wants to take.

components.name: conflict-alert
components.description: The user edited files an agent is working on.

components.name: persistence-setting-row
components.description: Whether DeepReview trace data survives after a session ends.

components.name: session-lane
components.description: OPTION 1 — Role swimlane.

components.name: notification-components
components.description: Status notification banners for system feedback.

components.name: button
components.description: Primary interactive control for triggering actions.

components.name: icon-button
components.description: Compact button containing only an icon, without a text label.

components.name: main-menu-buttons
components.description: Navigation buttons for the application main menu bar.

components.name: check box
components.description: Toggle control for binary or indeterminate selection.

components.name: field
components.description: Text input field for user data entry.

components.name: menu-item
components.description: Individual row within a dropdown or context menu.

components.name: tab
components.description: Tab control for switching between content panels.

components.name: switch
components.description: Binary toggle control for on/off settings.

components.name: switch-label
components.description: Switch toggle paired with a descriptive text label.

components.name: code-icons
components.description: Small utility icons used in code-related UI contexts.

components.name: browser-icons 24x24
components.description: Window control icons at 24×24 pixel size for the application title bar.

components.name: nav-icons 16x16
components.description: Debugger navigation icons at 16×16 pixel size.

components.name: alert-icons
components.description: Status indicator icons for notification and alert contexts.

components.name: extended-icon-set
components.description: Extended icon set — the full glyph library used across CodeTracer beyond the core ui-icons (569 variants).

components.name: ui-icons
components.description: General-purpose interface icons for common actions and navigation.

components.name: dot
components.description: Dot — a small status/indicator dot.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Tooltip — a small floating label that explains a control, value or icon on hover/focus.

components.name: text area
components.description: Multi-line text input.

components.name: dropdown-item
components.description: Dropdown item — one selectable option inside a dropdown menu; the building block for single- and multi-select menus.

components.name: method-badge
components.description: Method badge — a small HTTP-method pill for tables and request logs.

components.name: table-cell
components.description: Table cell — a single data cell for building tables.

components.name: table-row
components.description: Table row — one data row for the network-requests table, composed from table-cell + method-badge across the columns (# · method · URL · STATUS · DURATION · SIZE).

components.name: table-header-cell
components.description: Table header cell — a column header label (uppercase, muted).

components.name: badge
components.description: Small status pill for counts, states and labels.

components.name: chart-column
components.description: One bar in a bar chart.

components.name: chart-legend-item
components.description: One entry in a chart legend.

components.name: chart-bar
components.description: Bar chart for admin and fleet dashboards.

components.name: breadcrumb-item
components.description: One segment of the header breadcrumb.

components.name: nav-item
components.description: One entry in the side navigation.

components.name: list-item
components.description: One row in a list — task sidebar, changed files, search results.

components.name: top-nav
components.description: Application header.

components.name: avatar
components.description: User or agent identity marker.

components.name: loader
components.description: Indeterminate activity spinner.

components.name: progress-circle
components.description: Determinate radial progress.
